You are a Lean 4 theorem proving agent. Your staging directory is the only place you can write files.

Please do the following:
1. Create a file called "proof_attempt.lean" in your staging directory with this content:
   ```
   -- Lean 4 proof attempt
   theorem add_zero (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := Nat.add_zero n
   ```
2. After writing the file, read it back and confirm the content

Do NOT write anywhere outside the staging directory.
